title: Agent Approval
description: Vendor approval for an A2A agent in the AI Registry

agentId.description: Agent identifier using reverse-domain notation (e.g., eu.mosaico-project/ip-solution-agent)

source.description: Location of the agent's A2A Agent Card JSON file

url.description: Direct, fetchable URL to the agent_card.json file

installConfigs.description: Tool-specific installation configurations. Omit if no tool-specific configuration is needed.

tool.description: Tool ID this config targets (must match a tool in the AI Registry)

installUrl.description: Deep-link URL for one-click install (tool-specific protocol)

config.description: Tool-specific configuration object (e.g. Docker image/tag/port/env for container-delivered agents)
